decision: Option B. The universal template override was reverted; a narrow post-type-scoped CSS rule now corrects project cards only.

timeline.state: search template source=theme, block aspectRatio 3/2 (implicit cover). Plates clipped 11.1% vertically. Legacy 16:9 side-cropped 15.6%, legacy 3:2 exact fill.
search template override wp_id 7527 created with aspectRatio 4/3 + scale contain. Plates whole, but ALL results moved to 4/3 contain, giving 16:9 a 25% letterbox and 3:2 an 11.1% letterbox.
override deleted (template byte-identical to original), scoped CSS added to the child theme's global styles. Plates whole via CSS; every non-project result back to the original 3/2 cover.

css_applied_live.where: WordPress global styles post id 4940, title 'Custom Styles', bound to theme nadlan-platform-child. This is the block-theme equivalent of Additional CSS and is scoped to the child theme.
css_applied_live.state_before: styles was an empty object; there was no css value
css_applied_live.rule: body.search-results li.wp-block-post.type-nadlan_project .wp-block-post-featured-image img { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3 !important; object-fit: contain !important; }
css_applied_live.why_important: the query loop writes a non-important inline style, so a stylesheet !important wins the cascade; proven live with a sentinel test before anything was saved
css_applied_live.why_no_figure_rule: measured, not assumed: .wp-block-post-featured-image computes aspect-ratio auto, display block, margin 0, overflow visible and has no independent height, so its height follows the img
css_applied_live.why_body_search_results: keeps the rule strictly inside Search Results as instructed; the class was verified present on live search pages

permanent_home_in_repo.note: committed on the isolated branch only, not deployed. When this file ships, remove the global-styles copy so the rule is not defined twice.

rollback.css: await wp.apiFetch({path:'/wp/v2/global-styles/4940',method:'POST',data:{styles:{}}})  // restores the exact prior state (empty styles object)
